members.name: ownerPeerId
members.doc:
peerId that owns this shooter (its controlling client). 0 = server-owned.
The server sets this at spawn; OwnerOnly RPC authority checks against it.

members.name: FireShot
members.signature: void FireShot(const Vec3& origin, const Vec3& direction)
members.doc:
Fire a shot that replicates to every peer. On a client it ships a
client→server Fire RPC (the server re-broadcasts it); on the server it
applies locally and broadcasts to all clients. The shot is an EVENT,
not continuous state — exactly the target game's model.

members.name: shotsFired
members.doc: discrete-state stream so a dropped RPC never leaves a peer's count wrong.

members.name: lastShotOrigin
members.doc:
Last shot's origin / direction — bookkeeping the demo reads to draw a
tracer. Not replicated as fields; they arrive via the Fire RPC args.

members.name: ServerFire
members.doc:
Client → server request: "the owning client fired." MFUNCTION(Server)
declares the direction, so registration auto-installs an OwnerOnly
policy — only the peer that owns the pawn may send it, with no manual
AllowClientRpc. The authoritative effect belongs to the multicast, so
the body is empty. Void return + POD/Vec3 args keep it marshallable.

members.name: MulticastFire
members.doc:
Server → every client: the shot happened. Runs on the server and on each
ghost, bumping the replicated counter and recording the shot so the demo
can react (tracer, sound, hit). MFUNCTION(Multicast, Reliable) declares
it server-authoritative — a client that tries to send it is refused.
